Jonas — great to speak with you. Answers below to help unblock.

1) Billing route: We prefer PO via our Coupa instance.
- Net terms: standard is Net 60 for platform vendors, pending vendor approval.
- Marketplace: we only use marketplaces for certain suppliers; for platform APIs we typically onboard directly.

2) Vendor portal details:
- Portal: Coupa (https://coupa.mercuryhealth.com)
- Procurement contact: procurement@mercuryhealth.com (please CC Lisa Park when you submit vendor paperwork)

3) Tax paperwork: attaching our completed W-9 (Mercury_W9.pdf). If Redwood needs to complete a supplier form, send it over and I’ll route to our team.

4) Banking/template: Our AP team requires payment remittance fields in the vendor record. I don’t have a special template — Coupa handles the routing. If you need bank info for setup, we’ll request it via the portal once the vendor record exists.

Next steps on our side: We’ll queue a vendor creation request when we have Redwood’s legal name, remit-to address, and Redwood’s tax ID (if you prefer we can create a placeholder and update after SA).

Attaching: Mercury_W9.pdf
